Module com.mathcat.mathcat
Package com.mathcat.mathcat.services

Class LevelSystem

java.lang.Object
com.mathcat.mathcat.services.LevelSystem
public final class LevelSystem extends Object
Manages XP gain and level progression rules for the cat. The Cat holds current XP and level as data; this class owns the rules.
